source_semantics.input: A complete SiteBrainProfile whose SiteId determines the persistence key.
source_semantics.timestamp: SaveAsync serializes a copy with UpdatedAtUtc overwritten by server UTC.
source_semantics.persistence: SingleOrDefault by the site-derived key, add when absent, SetValue when present, then SaveChangesAsync.
source_semantics.result: No return payload; successful completion means the upsert committed.
source_semantics.external_side_effect: None. The canonical operation does not call an AI provider or WordPress.

laravel_adaptation.storage: Existing tenant-scoped scoped_settings row with scope=site, key=site_brain.profile and site_key=site:{site_id}.
laravel_adaptation.create_or_update: AdministrationService::saveSetting performs the existing-row update or first-row insert; SiteBrainService wraps it in a transaction.
laravel_adaptation.timestamp_truth: Caller supplied updated_at_utc is discarded and replaced with now('UTC')->toIso8601String() before persistence.
laravel_adaptation.typed_profile_contract: Canonical required string fields are type checked; canonical defaulted goal/keyword/competitor/schedule/autopilot fields retain their source defaults when omitted.

security_and_tenancy.authorization: TenantAuthorizer::authorize runs before any lookup or write.
security_and_tenancy.tenant_isolation: Site is loaded through the tenant-scoped Site model under the active TenantContext; a foreign tenant site ID fails with ModelNotFoundException before persistence.
security_and_tenancy.actor: The active tenant membership user_id is used by existing AdministrationService audit persistence.

acceptance: exact canonical operation/source identity and SaveAsync source behavior
create path persists one site-scoped profile with server UTC timestamp
update path changes the existing row in place without duplicate settings
missing settings.manage permission rejection before persistence
invalid typed profile rejection without partial write
existing setting.saved audit evidence for the successful mutation
